answer: A bonded trust network combats Sybil attacks by requiring agents to stake capital on peer endorsements, yielding an audit trail as transparent as crystal. Automated monitors act as a lantern to illuminate collusive routing, forcing an attacker seeking to mirror legitimate reputations to incur the scarce cost of locked financial collateral per identity. However, this economic barrier penalizes newly deployed, capital-poor agents and encourages collusive cartels.
